title: Estimating the Value of Offsite Tracking Data to Advertisers: Evidence from Meta
authors: Nils Wernerfelt; Anna E. Tuchman; Bradley T. Shapiro; Robert Moakler
eligible_reason: Large-scale randomized field experiment at Meta on the value of offsite tracking data; the package ships only an empirical-Bayes deconvolution of simulated treatment effects. No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: data_generation.R simulates treatment effects and standard errors; ebd.R runs Efron empirical Bayes deconvolution (deconvolveR-style) to recover the latent effect distribution.
data_files_note: README.txt: data.rdata contains 'a simulated set of treatment effects and standard errors'.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
